notes.title: Price Change Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

After much thought, I've decided to change Tail Trail from paid to free.
(price change will take effect in a few days)

I want to express my gratitude to those who purchased it and supported me.
Moving to a free model aims to introduce the game to a broader audience.
Given the absence of any marketing efforts over the years and with no plans in sight, I do not anticipate any financial gains in the future hence the change.

As a solo game developer, I would much rather have the game played than not at all.
Thank you very much for your support.
